name: tf-study-shelf-web
description: TF Study Shelf — Web Platform (Admin CMS + User-Facing Portal)

scripts.dev:workers: cd workers && npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist/client --project-name tfstudyshelfweb
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist/client --project-name tfstudyshelfweb --branch main
scripts.db:migrate: cd workers && npx wrangler d1 execute tf-study-shelf-db --file=src/db/schema.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: cd workers && npx wrangler d1 execute tf-study-shelf-db-staging --file=src/db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: cd workers && npx wrangler d1 execute tf-study-shelf-db --file=src/db/seed.sql
